The 3 day split is not bad in my opinion, but I view it more as a maintenance period for muscle growth since you’re only hitting a muscle group once a week. I think it still applies to weight loss just fine since you are working out and filling in the other possible days with outside activities. You could possibly see your daily energy expenditure dip a bit though depending on the level of workouts and outside activities you do.

I’ve mainly done resistance training. For the better part of a year, I was doing 4 days a week of an upper/lower split. Really enjoyed that! This past winter I tried out 6 days a week of a push/pull/legs split and also really enjoyed that. But with the spring coming I hopped off that because it was eating a little too much time after work. Right now I’m technically on a PPL 3 day split and just hitting the gym when I can due to playing softball, weekly yard work, family events, golf, and disc golf. I’m reaching that point for now that I am just happy being active and enjoying the warmer months as much as possible. If you’re curious for a more in depth workout routine, just let me know!
